neighbours.label: A number written in digits after a space, read at the lone space token just before the digits, in any language ('built in 1937', 'عام 1998', 'живут 450 человек'); strongest on an Arabic comma ، right after such a year. Also the split-off final 'ث' of Arabic حدث ('happened'). Spelled-out numbers, digits glued to '$', and plain text without digits stay low.
neighbours.short: space before a number in digits
neighbours.notes: Weak, broad pole (max 8.06, 8.8% of tokens reach 0.1 of max). Probes: the bare space before digits reads 0.16-0.23 in English, Russian, Korean, Arabic (incl. Arabic-Indic digits); a doubled space in plain English reads 0.16; spelled-out numbers and '$40' 0.04-0.08; Chinese spelled numbers go negative. Fire items sit near the 0.20 median bar. Feeders (attribution): mostly unlabelled; labelled ones are Arabic al- (L0/N6145+), ' إ' (L0/N6666-) and byte-piece ' �' (L23/N11964+). The reader label has little to do with its feeder L34/N3295- (Chinese 的); drop 0.19. Blind test by a label-only second author.
